title: Craftsman desk clock
text: Craftsman desk clock. Wow... this is a beautiful, hand crafted in the USA clock.  It's actually a brick of real wood.  Very nicely detailed and finished.  Smooth and designed nicely.  One thing I will note is that you will need to pop the clock out of the wood to change the time or replace the battery.  As this clock will be living in Arizona I don't have to worry about changing the time for daylight savings so it will be just to replace the battery.  The face is white and I can easily see it from a distance away.  The measurements given accurate... it's about 7" tall.  And really more beautiful in person than in the pics.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: American Made Craftsman Style Desk Clock, Cherry and Walnut, 7.75"
features: Reminiscent of the American Arts and Crafts Style, the Craftsman Desk Clock is precisely crafted with solid cherry and walnut wood
Natural kiln-dried woods are native to the Appalachian Mountains, provided with a hand-rubbed oil finish
Meas1ures 7.75" tall x 6" wide (recessed clock face measures 3.25")
US-made quartz timepiece accepts a single AA battery
Designed and made in the USA
